one_liner: Cloud platform for static sites and Serverless functions with a comprehensive REST API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Hobby plan and generate API tokens or use self-serve OAuth without talking to sales.
verdict_reason: Vercel provides a fully documented public REST API and official MCP server with self-serve signup.

evidence.snippet: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer
Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
